rows.d: A hidden five-step chain of items that starts with a sunken box in the Garden of Kharid and ends with a Chaos witch's wand.
s: Cast Telekinetic Grab on the sunken box, hidden under a root in the Garden of Kharid, to get a Sodden note.
Use the Sodden note on the washing line south of Sydekix (Garden of Kharid) to get a Dry note.
Use a spade to dig in front of the door that leads to the Phoenix Gang Hideout in Varrock to get a Lockbox.
Use a dust rune on the Lockbox to get a Note.

With a Toktz-ket-xil equipped or in your inventory, use a spade to dig in front of the statue of a dragonkin on floor 2 of the Daemonheim castle (stand in front of its broken wing, with the Note in your inventory). You get the Chaos witch's wand, found along with a Buried note.

m.l: Garden of Kharid (sunken box, washing line)

rows.d: Turn a Trinket from Bricks into a vibrating orb using Trinks, the Ancient statue and the blood altar.
s: Use a random amount of Limestone brick on Bricks to get a Trinket.
Trade the Trinket with Trinks to get a Strange glowing orb.
Use the Strange glowing orb on the Ancient statue and then on the blood altar within two minutes to get the Strange glowing orb (red).
Use the red orb on the Ancient statue to get the Strange glowing orb (vibrating).

rows.d: The longest hidden chain: twelve trades and interactions that end with a Cut luminous ball.
s: Get an Expired spin ticket from Yelps or his chest after The Mighty Fall (Yelps is far west on Yu'biusk, entered from the Yu'biusk portal).
Trade the ticket with Wizard Goldberg at the Runecrafting Guild for a Nearly boiled egg.
Trade the egg with Kipple Nano for Ruined essence. This needs Heart of Stone, the Kipple Nano pet owned, and the pet summoned.
Trade the Ruined essence with Brother Celerity at Edgeville Monastery for a Creepy doll.
Interact with the Creepy doll while standing near Wizard Chambers at the desert goebie camp to get Apollo's helmet.
Trade the helmet with a player-specific goebie on Mazcab for a Magic flute.
After Call of the Ancestors, use the flute on Lunch (east of Kanatah) four times in a row to get a Goebie disguise kit.
After Beneath Cursed Tides, use the kit with a delicious seaweed to get an Underwater disguise kit.
Have the lava ball, daystone, nightstone and mysterious bottle from the Heart of Gielinor in your inventory and use one of them on the kit to get a Broken disguise kit.
Use the Broken disguise kit on Feng, the Bounty Master in the Heart of Gielinor to get a Signal horn.
Use the Signal horn in Telos's arena in the Heart of Gielinor after defeating him to get an Odd luminous ball.
Use a chisel on the Odd luminous ball to get a Cut luminous ball.

rows.d: Dig up a Rusty chest at a sextant coordinate to start a four-step chain. The Magical feather also unlocks the Exhausted Rest animation.
rq: Ironman: Archaeology 70 (not boostable), to obtain quintessence
s: Use a spade at 07 degrees 52 minutes north, 02 degrees 13 minutes east on a sextant (the location shown on a Buried Treasure treasure map; you do not need the map) to dig up a Rusty chest.
Use the Rusty chest on Wizard Rinsit to get a Magical feather.
To unlock the Exhausted Rest animation override, interact with the Magical feather while your run energy is at 0%.
Use the Magical feather on the travelling merchant to get an Ancient scroll.
Read the Ancient scroll in War's Retreat with 1 empty pot, 1 pot lid, 4 air runes and 4 quintessences to get a Pot of souls.
rows.tip: Wiki tip: put the feather on a keybind and use it just as run energy hits 0%.

m.l: Dig spot (treasure map location near the Combat Training Camp)

rows.d: A two-step hidden chain: a Silvery feather from a kennel in Fort Forinthry, traded for a Red woad in Amberfell.
s: After Princess and the Pauper, get a Silvery feather from the kennel in Fort Forinthry.
After Secrets of Amberfell, use the Silvery feather on Fern in Amberfell to get a Red woad.

rows.d: A hidden title: replay a short part of Sliske's Endgame to get Armadyl's feather, then use it on May.
s: Start Sliske's Endgame again from Relomia in Draynor Village and tick "Replace maze with interactions only". Do not change the order on the Interactions tab. If you do choose a custom order, do the Armadyl and Seren interaction first and the Armadyl alone interaction after the first part of the maze.
Choose to forfeit the rewards.
Talk with Relomia, get teleported to the maze entrance, then enter the maze by speaking with Relomia and go through all the dialogue.
Halfway through the maze, select Armadyl as the god who loses his followers.
When the Armadyl alone interaction happens, accept his feather when asked (the option appears in all dialogue branches of that encounter).
Use Armadyl's feather on May. You keep the feather.

rows.d: A hidden title from Prifddinas. Dialogue from Mod Sarah appears when you finish it.
s: Equip a Clan Crwys cape while having exactly three cooking apples and chocolate bars in your inventory (wiki wording).
Attempt to take the memoriam crystal (unknown) near the bank chest in the Meilyr district of Prifddinas.
Use the memoriam crystal (unknown) on the memoriam device in the Tower of Voices. Mod Sarah's dialogue appears and you get the title.

m.l: Meilyr district and Tower of Voices, Prifddinas

rows.d: A companion pet hatched from a rare Mysterious egg that the Dragonkin Laboratory can drop.
s: Go into the Dragonkin Laboratory (elite dungeon) with lucky charms in your backpack. The egg can only be obtained while you have lucky charms in your backpack.
Wearing equipment with the Mysterious perk drastically raises the drop chance (wiki). When it works you see "You feel something mysterious take effect."
Inspect the Mysterious egg. It disappears and unlocks the Mysterious Chicken companion pet.

rows.d: While Malcolm, the Invention skilling pet, is out, his light bulb blinks a hidden phrase in Morse code.
s: Unlock Malcolm by inspecting the Malcolm pet, found while training Invention.
Summon Malcolm as your active pet.
Watch his bulb blink. In Morse code it says "Existence is pain".

rows.d: Distracting the eyes in the Abyss sometimes makes your character do the Chicken Dance emote, even without a Rubber chicken.

rw.n: Chicken Dance (seen as a random reaction)

s: Enter the Abyss and go to the eyes in the outer ring.
Distract the eyes (level 30 Thieving).
Sometimes your player will perform the Chicken Dance emote.

rows.d: Use an air rune on the Motherlode Maw. The rune is not used up, and you get an item with no known use.
rq: Access to the Motherlode Maw (indirectly Dungeoneering 115 and Plague's End, per the wiki)
s: Go to the Motherlode Maw with an air rune.
Use the air rune on the Motherlode Maw. The air rune is not consumed.
Study the Ancient air rune for its hidden message. Only one can be owned at a time.

rows.d: A joke item found in pet droppings. It does nothing; Mod Daze called it "just a fun little Easter egg".
rq: A legendary pet with the Fertiliser ability
s: Use the Fertiliser ability of a legendary pet to dig for compost or supercompost.
Each dig has a 1/10,000 chance of giving the homework.

rows.d: A rubber duck easter egg item with the same 1/10,000 chance from the legendary pet Fertiliser ability.
rq: A legendary pet with the Fertiliser ability
s: Use the Fertiliser ability of a legendary pet to dig for compost or supercompost.
Each dig has a 1/10,000 chance of giving the duck.
Throw it at the drake in Falador Park for the message "The duck doesn't want to eat that!".

rows.d: Ask a candle seller for "four candles" and get a Fork handle instead, for free. It unlocks the Handles for Forks achievement.
rq: At least 4 candles in the shop's stock
s: Open a candle shop, such as the Candle Shop in Catherby or Jossik in the Lighthouse.
On the white candle choose "Buy 4" (it normally reads "Buy 5"), or use the buttons to buy exactly 4 white candles.
You get a Fork handle and are not charged any coins. The shop's stock still drops by 4.
rows.tip: Free-to-play players can now get the achievement (Havenhythe update, 23 March 2026).

rows.d: Type one of these phrases into a note and it is shown as a pop-culture reference or meme instead.
s: Open Notes (Options menu > Community > Social tab).
Add a note that contains exactly one of the phrases below (case insensitive).
The note is displayed as the result text. When you edit the note, the original text you typed is still shown.

rows: All your base are belong to us
All rest and no play makes Guthix a dull boy.
All rest and no play makes Guthix a dull boy.
Come with me if you want to live.
They must love the smell of hero.
Then you will see, it is not the spoon that bends, it is only yourself.
You fight like a dairy farmer
How appropriate. You fight like a cow.
The ratio of people to cake is too big.
Marmaros had a close encounter with a prayer-eating behemoth.
Not as dead as we thought!

rows.d: Using certain items on a crystal tree shard gives joke messages.
s: Find a crystal tree (the wiki lists eight locations).
Use one of the items below on a crystal tree shard.
Read the message in your chat box.

rows: Crystal seed, crystal teleport seed, crystal trinket or crystal bow
You'll have to do better than that to get another crystal key.
You won't be able to see into the future with these.
Well it's not quite the Crystal Maize, now is it?
Silver or gold Castle Wars ticket
Not exactly a Fortress of Solitude is it?
Ah, Polycrystal, I see what you did there.

rows.d: Using certain items on an elder tree gives joke messages, including Skyrim references.
s: Find an elder tree (the wiki lists twelve locations).
Use one of the items below on the tree.
Read the message in your chat box.

rows: It's a nightmare to get out of the ground.
I used to be a woodcutter like you, until I took an arrow in the knee.
I'd kiln for one of those

rows.d: Try to release a raw fish back into a fishing spot. A raw sea turtle gives a World of Warcraft reference.
s: Get any raw fish.
Use it on a fishing spot anywhere outside Daemonheim. You get a few messages and the Catch and Release achievement.
Try a raw sea turtle to change the last line to "A turtle has made it to the water! Kind of."
rows.tip: Fish from a baited magical fishing spot do not work ("Nothing interesting happens.").

rows.d: Ask Magda in Ashdale about Guthix four times in a row and she talks about a cat she once had with the same name.
s: Travel to Ashdale (Ashdale lodestone or a games necklace) and find Magda's tower, south of the lodestone.
Talk to Magda and ask about Guthix.
Ask about Guthix 4 times in a row. She tells you about a cat she once had by the same name.

rows.d: A rock beside the River Lum that works as a fully functioning range. A homage to The Rock, added by Mod Pi.
rq: Rebuilding Edgeville (or, before it is covered by the roof, not yet completed Ritual of the Mahjarrat)
s: Find the rock just west of fairy ring DKR, between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange on the east bank of the River Lum.
Use any cookable item on the rock.
Read the message: "Can you smell, what the rock, is, cooking?"

rows.d: A hidden minigame in the Pit of Trials, run by Lefty and Righty. The first to ten points wins.
rq: The Beastmaster Durzag fight in the Liberation of Mazcab
s: Fight Beastmaster Durzag in the Pit of Trials.
After the fight, repair the four gongs on the walls and ring them in the order North, North, South, South, West, East, West, East.
Talk to Lefty or Righty to put the ball in play.
Move to where the ball will land to hit it back. Missing gives a point to the other side. Play until ten points.

rows.d: The pack yak has had dialogue since 2008, made available as an easter egg when the Pack yak mask arrived in 2018.
s: Get a Pack yak mask, a cosmetic mask from master clue scrolls.
Wear the Pack yak mask. While worn you can understand what the pack yak says.
Summon a pack yak and interact with it.

rows.d: A non-interactive crystal cow figurine, a nod to player requests for crystal cows when Prifddinas came out.
s: Go to the Amlodd Clan district in Prifddinas.
Find Daffyd's desk.
Look next to Hingy on top of the desk. Moomlyr is sat there.

rows.d: A little Har-Aken NPC (Shrimpy) shows up during the TzKal-Zuk fight.
s: Take on TzKal-Zuk.
When Zuk confronts the player himself, look at the gate to the east. Shrimpy appears behind it (not shown as a yellow dot on the minimap).

rows.d: A rare king spawn variant that can appear in the final wave of Barbarian Assault hard mode.
rq: Barbarian Assault hard mode, final wave (Penance King)
s: Reach the final wave of Barbarian Assault hard mode, the fight with the Penance King.
Each time a king spawn appears there is a 1/1,000 chance it is an Ospawn instead.
Take it out at range. If it touches you, or is killed near you, it deals 25% of your maximum health in an area. If left alone it explodes on its own.

rows.d: The Rubber chicken page is marked as discontinued content, and the wiki says the egg-eating way of triggering the dance stopped working when the event ended.
s: The dance used to be triggered by eating one of the Easter event's Easter eggs. Once the event ended this no longer worked.

rows.d: Found rarely in huge piles of Easter eggs during the Grand Theft Cocoa Easter event (8 to 15 April 2020), which has ended.
s: Collect from huge piles of Easter eggs during the event to rarely find the card.
Give it to the Easter Bunny for a faded easter letter.
Give the letter to Caelyn Kadaan for Caelyn's spare hat and a jewelled egg.
